source_text: Dammit. Where did they go?

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.Dammit. Where did they go?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp.Dammit. Where did they go?"

translation: Cholera. Gdzie oni poszli?

source_text: This is the back door…

structure.raw_value: LiBaDe^.This is the back door…
structure.script_literal: "LiBaDe^.This is the back door…"

translation: To tylne wejście…

source_text: This mansion is nestled against Casula Forest. The forest is very thick here…

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx^.This mansion is nestled against Casula Forest. The forest is very thick here…
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx^.This mansion is nestled against Casula Forest. The forest is very thick here…"

translation: Rezydencja leży tuż przy lesie Casula. W tym miejscu las jest bardzo gęsty…

source_text: Shit… It might be difficult to track them.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Shit… It might be difficult to track them.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Shit… It might be difficult to track them."

translation: Cholera… Trudno będzie ich wytropić.

source_text: We have to move, now!

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx^.We have to move, now!
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx^.We have to move, now!"

translation: Musimy ruszać. Natychmiast!

source_text: Send three of your officers into the forest.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.Send three of your officers into the forest.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.Send three of your officers into the forest."

translation: Wyślij trzech funkcjonariuszy do lasu.

source_text: We’re going to need to post up and watch the exits.

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.We’re going to need to post up and watch the exits.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp.We’re going to need to post up and watch the exits."

translation: Musimy się rozstawić i obstawić wyjścia.

source_text: Lillian’s safety is of the utmost importance right now.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.Lillian’s safety is of the utmost importance right now.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.Lillian’s safety is of the utmost importance right now."

translation: Bezpieczeństwo Lillian jest teraz najważniejsze.

source_text: Greenly, Duffy, Alapopskalius, go chase after them.

structure.raw_value: BoBaEx>.Greenly, Duffy, Alapopskalius, go chase after them.
structure.script_literal: "BoBaEx>.Greenly, Duffy, Alapopskalius, go chase after them."

translation: Greenly, Duffy, Alapopskalius, ruszajcie za nimi.

source_text: And stick together!

structure.raw_value: BoAnOp>.And stick together!
structure.script_literal: "BoAnOp>.And stick together!"

translation: I trzymajcie się razem!

source_text: The rest of you, come with me. We’re not letting that lunatic come back here.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx<.The rest of you, come with me. We’re not letting that lunatic come back here.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx<.The rest of you, come with me. We’re not letting that lunatic come back here."

translation: Reszta za mną. Nie pozwolimy temu szaleńcowi tu wrócić.

source_text: Boy, am I glad you showed up, Miss Bhatt.

structure.raw_value: DaHaOp.Boy, am I glad you showed up, Miss Bhatt.
structure.script_literal: "DaHaOp.Boy, am I glad you showed up, Miss Bhatt."

translation: Ależ się cieszę, że pani przyszła, panno Bhatt.

source_text: David, I thought I told you to wait for backup.

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.David, I thought I told you to wait for backup.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.David, I thought I told you to wait for backup."

translation: David, mówiłam ci, żebyś zaczekał na wsparcie.

source_text: Blame Bobby.

structure.raw_value: DaAnEx.Blame Bobby.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnEx.Blame Bobby."

translation: To wina Bobby’ego.

source_text: We need to talk.

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.We need to talk.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp.We need to talk."

translation: Musimy porozmawiać.

source_text: I’m too close to retirement to let you get me killed, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: DaAnOp.I’m too close to retirement to let you get me killed, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnOp.I’m too close to retirement to let you get me killed, 1Hero."

translation: Jestem zbyt blisko emerytury, żeby pozwolić ci mnie zabić, 1Hero.

source_text: What the hell did I do?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.What the hell did I do?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.What the hell did I do?"

translation: Co ja, do cholery, zrobiłem?

source_text: Please let the others know about our new guests.

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx>.Please let the others know about our new guests.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx>.Please let the others know about our new guests."

translation: Proszę, poinformuj pozostałych o naszych nowych gościach.

source_text: Yes, madam.

structure.raw_value: HoBaOp.Yes, madam.
structure.script_literal: "HoBaOp.Yes, madam."

translation: Tak jest, proszę pani.

source_text: I’m so sorry about this, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: LiWoOp.I’m so sorry about this, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "LiWoOp.I’m so sorry about this, 1Hero."

translation: Bardzo mi przykro, 1Hero.

source_text: It’s okay, Lillian. It seems your father has left you more than just a mansion.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.It’s okay, Lillian. It seems your father has left you more than just a mansion.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.It’s okay, Lillian. It seems your father has left you more than just a mansion."

translation: W porządku, Lillian. Wygląda na to, że ojciec zostawił ci coś więcej niż tylko rezydencję.

source_text: What are you going to do? Are they going to come back for treasure?

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.What are you going to do? Are they going to come back for treasure?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl.What are you going to do? Are they going to come back for treasure?"

translation: Co zamierzasz zrobić? Wrócą po skarb?

source_text: My father has many treasures, but I am not aware of any treasure room…

structure.raw_value: LiBaDe.My father has many treasures, but I am not aware of any treasure room…
structure.script_literal: "LiBaDe.My father has many treasures, but I am not aware of any treasure room…"

translation: Mój ojciec miał wiele skarbów, ale nic mi nie wiadomo o żadnym skarbcu…

source_text: At least, nothing that’s more valuable than what is easily seen.

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx.At least, nothing that’s more valuable than what is easily seen.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx.At least, nothing that’s more valuable than what is easily seen."

translation: Przynajmniej nie o niczym cenniejszym niż to, co widać na pierwszy rzut oka.

source_text: Clearly that man wanted something special.

structure.raw_value: LiBaDe.Clearly that man wanted something special.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaDe.Clearly that man wanted something special."

translation: Najwyraźniej ten człowiek szukał czegoś wyjątkowego.

source_text: He’s a Guild leader. He’d be looking for artifacts.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.He’s a Guild leader. He’d be looking for artifacts.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.He’s a Guild leader. He’d be looking for artifacts."

translation: To przywódca Gildii. Pewnie szuka artefaktów.

source_text: I feel my safety has been compromised.

structure.raw_value: LiSaDe.I feel my safety has been compromised.
structure.script_literal: "LiSaDe.I feel my safety has been compromised."

translation: Nie czuję się już bezpieczna.

source_text: I hate to be the bearer of worse news, but I found Madalyn.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.I hate to be the bearer of worse news, but I found Madalyn.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.I hate to be the bearer of worse news, but I found Madalyn."

translation: Nie chcę przynosić jeszcze gorszych wieści, ale znalazłem Madalyn.

source_text: And that’s bad news? Where is she?

structure.raw_value: ErBaOp.And that’s bad news? Where is she?
structure.script_literal: "ErBaOp.And that’s bad news? Where is she?"

translation: I to zła wiadomość? Gdzie jest?

source_text: She was in the woods.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.She was in the woods.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.She was in the woods."

translation: Była w lesie.

source_text: She’s still here? That can’t be true. What more would she want from my family?

structure.raw_value: LiWoCl.She’s still here? That can’t be true. What more would she want from my family?
structure.script_literal: "LiWoCl.She’s still here? That can’t be true. What more would she want from my family?"

translation: Wciąż tu jest? To niemożliwe. Czego jeszcze chce od mojej rodziny?

source_text: Damn! Do you think she’s linked to that Guild guy?

structure.raw_value: ErWoOp.Damn! Do you think she’s linked to that Guild guy?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoOp.Damn! Do you think she’s linked to that Guild guy?"

translation: Cholera! Myślisz, że ma coś wspólnego z tym człowiekiem z Gildii?

source_text: I don’t know… Something strange is happening.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I don’t know… Something strange is happening.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I don’t know… Something strange is happening."

translation: Nie wiem… Dzieje się coś dziwnego.

source_text: What’s wrong, 1Hero? What did you see?

structure.raw_value: LiBaOp.What’s wrong, 1Hero? What did you see?
structure.script_literal: "LiBaOp.What’s wrong, 1Hero? What did you see?"

translation: Co się stało, 1Hero? Co widziałeś?

source_text: This will sound crazy, but Madalyn disappeared…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.This will sound crazy, but Madalyn disappeared…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.This will sound crazy, but Madalyn disappeared…"

translation: To zabrzmi niedorzecznie, ale Madalyn zniknęła…

source_text: She just vanished into thin air.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.She just vanished into thin air.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.She just vanished into thin air."

translation: Po prostu rozpłynęła się w powietrzu.

source_text: The forest is very thick. She could have easily evaded your search efforts.

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx.The forest is very thick. She could have easily evaded your search efforts.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx.The forest is very thick. She could have easily evaded your search efforts."

translation: Las jest bardzo gęsty. Mogła łatwo wymknąć się waszym poszukiwaniom.

source_text: It wasn’t like that. I was right up next to her… We had her cornered…

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.It wasn’t like that. I was right up next to her… We had her cornered…
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.It wasn’t like that. I was right up next to her… We had her cornered…"

translation: To nie tak. Stałem tuż obok niej… Nie miała dokąd uciec…

source_text: Then she just went up in a puff of smoke.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Then she just went up in a puff of smoke.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Then she just went up in a puff of smoke."

translation: A potem rozpłynęła się w obłoku dymu.

source_text: She did something… She had a smoke bomb.

structure.raw_value: ErAnDe.She did something… She had a smoke bomb.
structure.script_literal: "ErAnDe.She did something… She had a smoke bomb."

translation: Coś zrobiła… Miała bombę dymną.

source_text: No! She was naked. She didn’t have anything on her.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.No! She was naked. She didn’t have anything on her.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.No! She was naked. She didn’t have anything on her."

translation: Nie! Była naga. Nie miała przy sobie niczego.

source_text: This all sounds very strange.

structure.raw_value: LiBaDe.This all sounds very strange.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaDe.This all sounds very strange."

translation: To wszystko brzmi bardzo dziwnie.

source_text: Trust me. Madalyn is doing something… supernatural.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Trust me. Madalyn is doing something… supernatural.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Trust me. Madalyn is doing something… supernatural."

translation: Zaufaj mi. Madalyn robi coś… nadprzyrodzonego.

source_text: I didn’t take you for the type to believe such things.

structure.raw_value: LiBaDe.I didn’t take you for the type to believe such things.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaDe.I didn’t take you for the type to believe such things."

translation: Nie sądziłam, że wierzysz w takie rzeczy.

source_text: I don’t!... I mean… I didn’t.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I don’t!... I mean… I didn’t.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I don’t!... I mean… I didn’t."

translation: Nie wierzę!... To znaczy… Nie wierzyłem.

source_text: Something is going on in the forest and I need to figure it out.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Something is going on in the forest and I need to figure it out.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Something is going on in the forest and I need to figure it out."

translation: Coś się dzieje w lesie i muszę się dowiedzieć co.

source_text: Maybe you should tell us what you know, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ErAnDe.Maybe you should tell us what you know, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ErAnDe.Maybe you should tell us what you know, 1Hero."

translation: Może powiesz nam, co wiesz, 1Hero.

source_text: I don’t know what’s going on.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I don’t know what’s going on.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I don’t know what’s going on."

translation: Nie wiem, co się dzieje.

source_text: You knew that woman… and she knew that Guild dude.

structure.raw_value: ErAnEx.You knew that woman… and she knew that Guild dude.
structure.script_literal: "ErAnEx.You knew that woman… and she knew that Guild dude."

translation: Znałeś tę kobietę… a ona znała tego faceta z Gildii.

source_text: You have a connection to the woman, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: LiBaDe.You have a connection to the woman, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "LiBaDe.You have a connection to the woman, 1Hero?"

translation: Łączy cię coś z tą kobietą, 1Hero?

source_text: That’s Nellie… She’s the mother of a friend of mine.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.That’s Nellie… She’s the mother of a friend of mine.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.That’s Nellie… She’s the mother of a friend of mine."

translation: To Nellie… Matka mojego znajomego.

source_text: You talk about trust, yet you have this connection to the Guild that you didn’t tell us about?

structure.raw_value: ErAnDe.You talk about trust, yet you have this connection to the Guild that you didn’t tell us about?
structure.script_literal: "ErAnDe.You talk about trust, yet you have this connection to the Guild that you didn’t tell us about?"

translation: Mówisz o zaufaniu, a sam zataiłeś przed nami swoje powiązania z Gildią?

source_text: It’s not like that. I just met the woman. I didn’t know anything about her connection to the Guild.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.It’s not like that. I just met the woman. I didn’t know anything about her connection to the Guild.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.It’s not like that. I just met the woman. I didn’t know anything about her connection to the Guild."

translation: To nie tak. Dopiero ją poznałem. Nie wiedziałem, że ma powiązania z Gildią.

source_text: I didn’t know until recently.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.I didn’t know until recently.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.I didn’t know until recently."

translation: Dowiedziałem się o tym dopiero niedawno.

source_text: I’m sure 1Hero has good intentions. I trust him.

structure.raw_value: LiFrOp.I’m sure 1Hero has good intentions. I trust him.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrOp.I’m sure 1Hero has good intentions. I trust him."

translation: Jestem pewna, że 1Hero ma dobre intencje. Ufam mu.

source_text: I’m going to figure this out. But until I do, you’re going to need to trust us…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’m going to figure this out. But until I do, you’re going to need to trust us…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’m going to figure this out. But until I do, you’re going to need to trust us…"

translation: Rozwiążę tę sprawę. Ale do tego czasu musicie nam zaufać…

source_text: We’ll make sure no one enters your home, Lillian.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.We’ll make sure no one enters your home, Lillian.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.We’ll make sure no one enters your home, Lillian."

translation: Dopilnujemy, żeby nikt nie wszedł do twojego domu, Lillian.

source_text: I don’t like the idea of having surveillance. But I understand.

structure.raw_value: LiSaDe.I don’t like the idea of having surveillance. But I understand.
structure.script_literal: "LiSaDe.I don’t like the idea of having surveillance. But I understand."

translation: Nie podoba mi się pomysł nadzoru, ale rozumiem.

source_text: Thank you, Miss Bhatt, for showing up when you did. I could almost call your timing divine.

structure.raw_value: LiFrOp.Thank you, Miss Bhatt, for showing up when you did. I could almost call your timing divine.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrOp.Thank you, Miss Bhatt, for showing up when you did. I could almost call your timing divine."

translation: Dziękuję, panno Bhatt, że przybyła pani w samą porę. Można by rzec, że to boskie zrządzenie.

source_text: Just doing our job, Miss Wilkes.

structure.raw_value: MeFrEx>.Just doing our job, Miss Wilkes.
structure.script_literal: "MeFrEx>.Just doing our job, Miss Wilkes."

translation: Po prostu wykonujemy swoją pracę, panno Wilkes.

source_text: Well, 1Hero, it seems you were onto something, after all.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.Well, 1Hero, it seems you were onto something, after all.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.Well, 1Hero, it seems you were onto something, after all."

translation: Cóż, 1Hero, wygląda na to, że jednak coś podejrzewałeś.

source_text: Just a…lucky hunch, Miss Bhatt.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.Just a…lucky hunch, Miss Bhatt.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.Just a…lucky hunch, Miss Bhatt."

translation: To tylko… szczęśliwe przeczucie, panno Bhatt.

source_text: Stop it. I’m sure working for me can be infuriating.

structure.raw_value: MeFlDe.Stop it. I’m sure working for me can be infuriating.
structure.script_literal: "MeFlDe.Stop it. I’m sure working for me can be infuriating."

translation: Przestań. Wiem, że praca dla mnie potrafi doprowadzić do szału.

source_text: But I give credit where it’s due, and you saw something I missed. Good job.

structure.raw_value: MeFrEx.But I give credit where it’s due, and you saw something I missed. Good job.
structure.script_literal: "MeFrEx.But I give credit where it’s due, and you saw something I missed. Good job."

translation: Ale doceniam zasługi, a ty zauważyłeś coś, co mi umknęło. Dobra robota.

source_text: Err… thank you, Miss Bhatt.

structure.raw_value: McFrCl.Err… thank you, Miss Bhatt.
structure.script_literal: "McFrCl.Err… thank you, Miss Bhatt."

translation: Eee… dziękuję, panno Bhatt.

source_text: You have the green light to watch her.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.You have the green light to watch her.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.You have the green light to watch her."

translation: Masz zielone światło, żeby ją obserwować.

source_text: Gain her trust, and find out what she knows.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.Gain her trust, and find out what she knows.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.Gain her trust, and find out what she knows."

translation: Zdobądź jej zaufanie i dowiedz się, co wie.

source_text: About her father and the Guild?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.About her father and the Guild?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.About her father and the Guild?"

translation: O jej ojcu i Gildii?

source_text: About everything. Duncan Helmer didn’t break in here for no reason.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.About everything. Duncan Helmer didn’t break in here for no reason.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.About everything. Duncan Helmer didn’t break in here for no reason."

translation: O wszystkim. Duncan Helmer nie włamał się tu bez powodu.

source_text: She has a connection to him.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.She has a connection to him.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.She has a connection to him."

translation: Coś ją z nim łączy.

source_text: We need to know who she really is.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.We need to know who she really is.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.We need to know who she really is."

translation: Musimy się dowiedzieć, kim naprawdę jest.

source_text: Sure thing. And thank you. I won’t let you down.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Sure thing. And thank you. I won’t let you down.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Sure thing. And thank you. I won’t let you down."

translation: Jasne. Dziękuję. Nie zawiodę pani.

source_text: See that you don’t.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.See that you don’t.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.See that you don’t."

translation: Lepiej tego nie rób.

source_text: We’ll need to throw Lillian off about our suspicions. Follow my lead.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.We’ll need to throw Lillian off about our suspicions. Follow my lead.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.We’ll need to throw Lillian off about our suspicions. Follow my lead."

translation: Musimy odwrócić uwagę Lillian od naszych podejrzeń. Rób, co mówię.

source_text: Shall we?

structure.raw_value: MeFlEx.Shall we?
structure.script_literal: "MeFlEx.Shall we?"

translation: Zaczynamy?

source_text: Get back or the commissioner gets a bullet in the head!

structure.raw_value: H2MaAg>.Get back or the commissioner gets a bullet in the head!
structure.script_literal: "H2MaAg>.Get back or the commissioner gets a bullet in the head!"

translation: Cofnijcie się, albo pani komisarz dostanie kulkę w głowę!

source_text: 1Hero!?

structure.raw_value: AdShClNo1.1Hero!?
structure.script_literal: "AdShClNo1.1Hero!? "

translation: 1Hero!?

source_text: Let her go, asshole!

structure.raw_value: McMaAgNo1.Let her go, asshole!
structure.script_literal: "McMaAgNo1.Let her go, asshole!"

translation: Puść ją, dupku!

source_text: Heh! Nice shot, kiddo.

structure.raw_value: DuFlOp.Heh! Nice shot, kiddo.
structure.script_literal: "DuFlOp.Heh! Nice shot, kiddo."

translation: Heh! Niezły strzał, mała.

source_text: I knew I could depend on you, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe.I knew I could depend on you, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe.I knew I could depend on you, 1Hero."

translation: Wiedziałam, że mogę na tobie polegać, 1Hero.

source_text: You have a lot of nerve, showing up here. Expect to assassinate me?

structure.raw_value: DuAnOp.You have a lot of nerve, showing up here. Expect to assassinate me?
structure.script_literal: "DuAnOp.You have a lot of nerve, showing up here. Expect to assassinate me?"

translation: Masz tupet, że tu przychodzisz. Zamierzasz mnie zabić?

source_text: I helped 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ElAnEx.I helped 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ElAnEx.I helped 1Hero."

translation: Pomogłam 1Hero.

source_text: Listen to the lady. She saved my life and probably yours.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx^.Listen to the lady. She saved my life and probably yours.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx^.Listen to the lady. She saved my life and probably yours."

translation: Posłuchaj jej. Uratowała mi życie, a pewnie i twoje.

source_text: We followed your goon through the old bunker.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.We followed your goon through the old bunker.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.We followed your goon through the old bunker."

translation: Śledziliśmy twojego zbira przez stary bunkier.

source_text: Uh, yeah. We totally tracked him down.

structure.raw_value: ElHaEx.Uh, yeah. We totally tracked him down.
structure.script_literal: "ElHaEx.Uh, yeah. We totally tracked him down."

translation: No tak. Udało nam się go wytropić.

source_text: That son of a bitch! Trying to get revenge on me, I’m sure.

structure.raw_value: DuMaAgNo1.That son of a bitch! Trying to get revenge on me, I’m sure.
structure.script_literal: "DuMaAgNo1.That son of a bitch! Trying to get revenge on me, I’m sure."

translation: Skurwysyn! Na pewno chciał się na mnie zemścić.

source_text: Well, he’s dead now.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx^.Well, he’s dead now.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx^.Well, he’s dead now."

translation: Cóż, już nie żyje.

source_text: What the hell do we do now? Pretend he got away?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.What the hell do we do now? Pretend he got away?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.What the hell do we do now? Pretend he got away?"

translation: Co my teraz, do cholery, zrobimy? Udawać, że uciekł?

source_text: I say we kill Morgan and then bury both bodies in the forest.

structure.raw_value: DuHaEx.I say we kill Morgan and then bury both bodies in the forest.
structure.script_literal: "DuHaEx.I say we kill Morgan and then bury both bodies in the forest."

translation: Zabijmy Morgan, a potem zakopmy oba ciała w lesie.

source_text: Duncan! Your obsession with revenge is going to lead to my downfall.

structure.raw_value: AdMaExNo1^.Duncan! Your obsession with revenge is going to lead to my downfall.
structure.script_literal: "AdMaExNo1^.Duncan! Your obsession with revenge is going to lead to my downfall."

translation: Duncan! Twoja obsesja na punkcie zemsty doprowadzi mnie do zguby.

source_text: Do you want to sleep at night, Duncan?

structure.raw_value: ElAnEx.Do you want to sleep at night, Duncan?
structure.script_literal: "ElAnEx.Do you want to sleep at night, Duncan?"

translation: Chcesz móc spokojnie spać, Duncan?

source_text: Haha! You’re the least of my concerns.

structure.raw_value: DuFlDeNo4.Haha! You’re the least of my concerns.
structure.script_literal: "DuFlDeNo4.Haha! You’re the least of my concerns."

translation: Haha! Najmniej się o ciebie martwię.

source_text: I have nothing left. You’ve backed me into a corner.

structure.raw_value: ElAnEx.I have nothing left. You’ve backed me into a corner.
structure.script_literal: "ElAnEx.I have nothing left. You’ve backed me into a corner."

translation: Nie mam już nic. Zapędziłeś mnie w kozi róg.

source_text: That was my money you took!

structure.raw_value: DuMaAgNo1.That was my money you took!
structure.script_literal: "DuMaAgNo1.That was my money you took!"

translation: Zabrałeś moje pieniądze!

source_text: Charles gave it to me!

structure.raw_value: ElAnEx.Charles gave it to me!
structure.script_literal: "ElAnEx.Charles gave it to me!"

translation: Charles mi je dał!

source_text: Leave us, Duncan… I’ll make the girl whole.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx^.Leave us, Duncan… I’ll make the girl whole.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx^.Leave us, Duncan… I’ll make the girl whole."

translation: Zostaw nas, Duncan… Wyrównam dziewczynie straty.

source_text: Fine… We’ll do it your way.

structure.raw_value: DuAnDe.Fine… We’ll do it your way.
structure.script_literal: "DuAnDe.Fine… We’ll do it your way."

translation: Dobra… Zrobimy po twojemu.

source_text: How much money are we talking about?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.How much money are we talking about?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.How much money are we talking about?"

translation: O jakich pieniądzach mówimy?

source_text: Ten million dollars.

structure.raw_value: ElBaEx.Ten million dollars.
structure.script_literal: "ElBaEx.Ten million dollars."

translation: Dziesięć milionów dolarów.

source_text: I’ve got a gold treasure she can take.

structure.raw_value: DuFlDe.I’ve got a gold treasure she can take.
structure.script_literal: "DuFlDe.I’ve got a gold treasure she can take."

translation: Mam złoty skarb, który może wziąć.

source_text: Tell me you didn’t bring a piece of Nadia’s treasure here.

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp^.Tell me you didn’t bring a piece of Nadia’s treasure here.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp^.Tell me you didn’t bring a piece of Nadia’s treasure here."

translation: Powiedz, że nie przyniosłeś tu fragmentu skarbu Nadii.

source_text: I never touched it. I know the rules.

structure.raw_value: DuAnEx.I never touched it. I know the rules.
structure.script_literal: "DuAnEx.I never touched it. I know the rules."

translation: Nigdy go nie tknąłem. Znam zasady.

source_text: Morgan… You’ll get two million.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx^.Morgan… You’ll get two million.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx^.Morgan… You’ll get two million."

translation: Morgan… Dostaniesz dwa miliony.

source_text: We’re even now, Morgan… But you cross me again and I’ll double the price on your head.

structure.raw_value: DuAnEx.We’re even now, Morgan… But you cross me again and I’ll double the price on your head.
structure.script_literal: "DuAnEx.We’re even now, Morgan… But you cross me again and I’ll double the price on your head."

translation: Jesteśmy kwita, Morgan… Ale jeśli jeszcze raz mi podpadniesz, podwoję nagrodę za twoją głowę.

source_text: Come on, Victor. Time to have you put into the ground.

structure.raw_value: DuHaOp.Come on, Victor. Time to have you put into the ground.
structure.script_literal: "DuHaOp.Come on, Victor. Time to have you put into the ground."

translation: Chodź, Victor. Pora cię zakopać.

source_text: Holy shit! I’m getting paid!...

structure.raw_value: ElHaAg.Holy shit! I’m getting paid!...
structure.script_literal: "ElHaAg.Holy shit! I’m getting paid!..."

translation: Ja pierdolę! Dostanę kasę!...

source_text: Wait… How do you have the power to order Duncan around?

structure.raw_value: ElWoCl.Wait… How do you have the power to order Duncan around?
structure.script_literal: "ElWoCl.Wait… How do you have the power to order Duncan around?"

translation: Chwila… Skąd masz władzę, żeby rozkazywać Duncanowi?

source_text: This is my operation now… Charles went crazy.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx^.This is my operation now… Charles went crazy.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx^.This is my operation now… Charles went crazy."

translation: Teraz to moja operacja… Charles postradał zmysły.

source_text: I suspected something was wrong with him.

structure.raw_value: ElWoOp.I suspected something was wrong with him.
structure.script_literal: "ElWoOp.I suspected something was wrong with him."

translation: Podejrzewałam, że coś jest z nim nie tak.

source_text: You’re lucky he didn’t get you killed.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx^.You’re lucky he didn’t get you killed.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx^.You’re lucky he didn’t get you killed."

translation: Masz szczęście, że nie doprowadził do twojej śmierci.

source_text: He almost did.

structure.raw_value: ElWoEx.He almost did.
structure.script_literal: "ElWoEx.He almost did."

translation: Prawie mu się udało.

source_text: How long have you been planning this… takeover?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.How long have you been planning this… takeover?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.How long have you been planning this… takeover?"

translation: Od jak dawna planujesz ten… przewrót?

source_text: The Guild was doomed to fall… Quite literally cursed.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx^.The Guild was doomed to fall… Quite literally cursed.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx^.The Guild was doomed to fall… Quite literally cursed."

translation: Gildia była skazana na upadek… Dosłownie ciążyła na niej klątwa.

source_text: Thanks to you and Nellie, I’ve managed to put together something new.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx^.Thanks to you and Nellie, I’ve managed to put together something new.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx^.Thanks to you and Nellie, I’ve managed to put together something new."

translation: Dzięki tobie i Nellie udało mi się stworzyć coś nowego.

source_text: This operation should be run by one individual… Not twelve.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx^.This operation should be run by one individual… Not twelve.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx^.This operation should be run by one individual… Not twelve."

translation: Tą organizacją powinna kierować jedna osoba… Nie dwanaście.

source_text: So you’re the sole leader?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.So you’re the sole leader?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.So you’re the sole leader?"

translation: Czyli jesteś jedyną przywódczynią?

source_text: You and I are going to be very powerful, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx^.You and I are going to be very powerful, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx^.You and I are going to be very powerful, 1Hero."

translation: Razem będziemy bardzo potężni, 1Hero.

source_text: Duncan’s not going to like that.

structure.raw_value: ElWoCl.Duncan’s not going to like that.
structure.script_literal: "ElWoCl.Duncan’s not going to like that."

translation: Duncanowi się to nie spodoba.

source_text: He has no choice. It’s either die, or be led by me.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx^.He has no choice. It’s either die, or be led by me.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx^.He has no choice. It’s either die, or be led by me."

translation: Nie ma wyboru. Albo zginie, albo będzie mi podlegał.

source_text: If the Guild’s not dead… Am I still on the payroll?

structure.raw_value: ElHaOp.If the Guild’s not dead… Am I still on the payroll?
structure.script_literal: "ElHaOp.If the Guild’s not dead… Am I still on the payroll?"

translation: Skoro Gildia wciąż istnieje… Nadal jestem na liście płac?

source_text: I could use a woman with your beauty.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp^.I could use a woman with your beauty.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp^.I could use a woman with your beauty."

translation: Przydałaby mi się kobieta taka piękna jak ty.

source_text: I can fight. I’m damn good at it.

structure.raw_value: ElFlEx.I can fight. I’m damn good at it.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlEx.I can fight. I’m damn good at it."

translation: Umiem walczyć. I to cholernie dobrze.

source_text: Ella? You’ve got a ticket out. Why would you want back in?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Ella? You’ve got a ticket out. Why would you want back in?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Ella? You’ve got a ticket out. Why would you want back in?"

translation: Ella? Masz szansę się stąd wydostać. Po co miałabyś wracać?

source_text: To earn that eight million back.

structure.raw_value: ElFlEx.To earn that eight million back.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlEx.To earn that eight million back."

translation: Żeby odzyskać te osiem milionów.

source_text: Beautiful and persistent… I like it.

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe^.Beautiful and persistent… I like it.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe^.Beautiful and persistent… I like it."

translation: Piękna i uparta… Podoba mi się.

source_text: The Guild is finally under the rule of a female… This should be interesting.

structure.raw_value: ElHaOp.The Guild is finally under the rule of a female… This should be interesting.
structure.script_literal: "ElHaOp.The Guild is finally under the rule of a female… This should be interesting."

translation: Gildią wreszcie rządzi kobieta… To będzie ciekawe.

source_text: It’s a honeypot… Don’t go thinking you’ll be stealing artifacts.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.It’s a honeypot… Don’t go thinking you’ll be stealing artifacts.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.It’s a honeypot… Don’t go thinking you’ll be stealing artifacts."

translation: To miodowa pułapka… Nie myśl, że będziesz kraść artefakty.

source_text: Let me worry about that, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp^.Let me worry about that, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp^.Let me worry about that, 1Hero."

translation: Zostaw to mnie, 1Hero.

source_text: Nellie and you have been integral to this operation, but I could always use more loyal associates.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx^.Nellie and you have been integral to this operation, but I could always use more loyal associates.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx^.Nellie and you have been integral to this operation, but I could always use more loyal associates."

translation: Ty i Nellie odegraliście kluczową rolę w tej operacji, ale zawsze przydadzą mi się lojalni współpracownicy.

source_text: I’m your woman.

structure.raw_value: ElHaOp.I’m your woman.
structure.script_literal: "ElHaOp.I’m your woman."

translation: Jestem twoją kobietą.

source_text: I killed that hitman. Isn’t that enough?

structure.raw_value: ElHaEx.I killed that hitman. Isn’t that enough?
structure.script_literal: "ElHaEx.I killed that hitman. Isn’t that enough?"

translation: Zabiłam tego płatnego mordercę. To nie wystarczy?

source_text: I have my own way of testing those around me… just ask 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx^.I have my own way of testing those around me… just ask 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx^.I have my own way of testing those around me… just ask 1Hero."

translation: Mam własne sposoby sprawdzania ludzi wokół siebie… Zapytaj 1Hero.

source_text: Remove your clothes, Morgan Deluna.

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe^.Remove your clothes, Morgan Deluna.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe^.Remove your clothes, Morgan Deluna."

translation: Rozbierz się, Morgan Deluna.

source_text: You can call me Ella.

structure.raw_value: ElFlOp.You can call me Ella.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlOp.You can call me Ella."

translation: Mów mi Ella.

source_text: Okay. It’s clear… Come on.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Okay. It’s clear… Come on.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Okay. It’s clear… Come on."

translation: Dobrze. Czysto… Chodź.

source_text: Can I call you?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Can I call you?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Can I call you?"

translation: Mogę do ciebie zadzwonić?

source_text: Come to my office Monday. We can go over the findings there.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.Come to my office Monday. We can go over the findings there.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.Come to my office Monday. We can go over the findings there."

translation: Przyjdź do mojego biura w poniedziałek. Omówimy tam ustalenia.

source_text: 1Hero. Is everything okay?

structure.raw_value: LiBaOp.1Hero. Is everything okay?
structure.script_literal: "LiBaOp.1Hero. Is everything okay?"

translation: 1Hero. Wszystko w porządku?

source_text: Oh, uhh. There was a report of suspicious activity, but all is clear.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Oh, uhh. There was a report of suspicious activity, but all is clear.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Oh, uhh. There was a report of suspicious activity, but all is clear."

translation: Och, yyy. Zgłoszono podejrzaną aktywność, ale wszystko jest już w porządku.

source_text: It’s getting late. Are you still working?

structure.raw_value: LiBaDe.It’s getting late. Are you still working?
structure.script_literal: "LiBaDe.It’s getting late. Are you still working?"

translation: Robi się późno. Nadal pracujesz?

source_text: Just heading out now. I’m looking forward to the weekend.

structure.raw_value: McHaEx.Just heading out now. I’m looking forward to the weekend.
structure.script_literal: "McHaEx.Just heading out now. I’m looking forward to the weekend."

translation: Właśnie wychodzę. Nie mogę się doczekać weekendu.

source_text: I assume the officer outside will be staying?

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx.I assume the officer outside will be staying?
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx.I assume the officer outside will be staying?"

translation: Zakładam, że funkcjonariusz na zewnątrz zostanie?

source_text: Yes. He’ll keep his eye peeled for anything suspicious.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Yes. He’ll keep his eye peeled for anything suspicious.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Yes. He’ll keep his eye peeled for anything suspicious."

translation: Tak. Będzie wypatrywał wszystkiego, co podejrzane.

source_text: Take care, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: LiFlOp.Take care, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlOp.Take care, 1Hero."

translation: Trzymaj się, 1Hero.

source_text: No sign of Lillian. What’s next?

structure.raw_value: ErBaDe.No sign of Lillian. What’s next?
structure.script_literal: "ErBaDe.No sign of Lillian. What’s next?"

translation: Nie ma śladu po Lillian. Co teraz?

source_text: Wait here. I’ll find Kimberly.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Wait here. I’ll find Kimberly.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Wait here. I’ll find Kimberly."

translation: Zaczekaj tutaj. Znajdę Kimberly.

source_text: Holy shit! Kimberly Foxx!

structure.raw_value: ErShCl.Holy shit! Kimberly Foxx!
structure.script_literal: "ErShCl.Holy shit! Kimberly Foxx!"

translation: Ja pierdolę! Kimberly Foxx!

source_text: You must be the maid.

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe^.You must be the maid.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe^.You must be the maid."

translation: Ty pewnie jesteś pokojówką.

source_text: Kimberly, meet Erica.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Kimberly, meet Erica.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Kimberly, meet Erica."

translation: Kimberly, poznaj Ericę.

source_text: 1Hero’s been telling me you’re helping him with his case.

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe^.1Hero’s been telling me you’re helping him with his case.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe^.1Hero’s been telling me you’re helping him with his case."

translation: 1Hero mówił mi, że pomagasz mu w śledztwie.

source_text: There’s something going on here… There’s a secret area in this mansion.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx^.There’s something going on here… There’s a secret area in this mansion.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx^.There’s something going on here… There’s a secret area in this mansion."

translation: Coś się tu dzieje… W tej rezydencji jest tajne pomieszczenie.

source_text: No shit. I’ve seen it.

structure.raw_value: ErBaDe.No shit. I’ve seen it.
structure.script_literal: "ErBaDe.No shit. I’ve seen it."

translation: No raczej. Widziałam je.

source_text: We have an opportunity to find our way inside and see for ourselves what’s going on.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.We have an opportunity to find our way inside and see for ourselves what’s going on.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.We have an opportunity to find our way inside and see for ourselves what’s going on."

translation: Możemy się tam dostać i na własne oczy zobaczyć, co się dzieje.

source_text: We just need you to distract the guards long enough for us to find the entrance.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.We just need you to distract the guards long enough for us to find the entrance.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.We just need you to distract the guards long enough for us to find the entrance."

translation: Musisz tylko zająć strażników na tyle długo, żebyśmy znaleźli wejście.

source_text: How long do you need?

structure.raw_value: ErWoDe.How long do you need?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoDe.How long do you need?"

translation: Ile czasu potrzebujecie?

source_text: We know where the eye… the key is.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx^.We know where the eye… the key is.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx^.We know where the eye… the key is."

translation: Wiemy, gdzie jest oko… klucz.

source_text: We just have to figure out where to use it.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.We just have to figure out where to use it.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.We just have to figure out where to use it."

translation: Musimy tylko ustalić, gdzie go użyć.

source_text: I can buy you some time. But you better hurry.

structure.raw_value: ErBaEx.I can buy you some time. But you better hurry.
structure.script_literal: "ErBaEx.I can buy you some time. But you better hurry."

translation: Mogę dać wam trochę czasu. Ale lepiej się pospieszcie.

source_text: We’ve got this.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp^.We’ve got this.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp^.We’ve got this."

translation: Poradzimy sobie.

source_text: There’s a guard in the next room. I’ll pull him away and then the clock starts.

structure.raw_value: ErBaEx.There’s a guard in the next room. I’ll pull him away and then the clock starts.
structure.script_literal: "ErBaEx.There’s a guard in the next room. I’ll pull him away and then the clock starts."

translation: W następnym pokoju jest strażnik. Odciągnę go, a wtedy zaczniecie działać.

source_text: But be careful.

structure.raw_value: ErWoEx.But be careful.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoEx.But be careful."

translation: Tylko uważajcie.

source_text: I’m going to keep tabs on the transmitters. Don’t forget we’re in this together.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.I’m going to keep tabs on the transmitters. Don’t forget we’re in this together.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.I’m going to keep tabs on the transmitters. Don’t forget we’re in this together."

translation: Będę monitorować nadajniki. Pamiętaj, że jesteśmy w tym razem.

source_text: You’re right. This isn’t over… It’s just the beginning.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.You’re right. This isn’t over… It’s just the beginning.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.You’re right. This isn’t over… It’s just the beginning."

translation: Masz rację. To jeszcze nie koniec… To dopiero początek.

source_text: I want to know what they are hiding.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.I want to know what they are hiding.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.I want to know what they are hiding."

translation: Chcę wiedzieć, co ukrywają.

source_text: … Me too.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.… Me too.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.… Me too."

translation: … Ja też.

source_text: See you around, 1Hero. Enjoy the news segment tonight.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.See you around, 1Hero. Enjoy the news segment tonight.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.See you around, 1Hero. Enjoy the news segment tonight."

translation: Do zobaczenia, 1Hero. Miłego oglądania wiadomości dziś wieczorem.

source_text: For now.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.For now.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.For now."

translation: Na razie.

source_text: What are they hiding down there, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: ErWoOp.What are they hiding down there, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoOp.What are they hiding down there, 1Hero?"

translation: Co oni tam ukrywają, 1Hero?

source_text: I saw the Toma piece and a pentagram on the floor…

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I saw the Toma piece and a pentagram on the floor…
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I saw the Toma piece and a pentagram on the floor…"

translation: Widziałem fragment Tomy i pentagram na podłodze…

source_text: There were six hooded statues all surrounding it.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.There were six hooded statues all surrounding it.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.There were six hooded statues all surrounding it."

translation: Otaczało go sześć posągów w kapturach.

source_text: What about the sound? Did you hear it?

structure.raw_value: ErWoOp.What about the sound? Did you hear it?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoOp.What about the sound? Did you hear it?"

translation: A ten dźwięk? Słyszałeś go?

source_text: No… If we’re going to figure out what’s being hidden down there, I’ll need to figure out a way to get deeper.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.No… If we’re going to figure out what’s being hidden down there, I’ll need to figure out a way to get deeper.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.No… If we’re going to figure out what’s being hidden down there, I’ll need to figure out a way to get deeper."

translation: Nie… Jeśli mamy odkryć, co ukrywają na dole, muszę znaleźć sposób, by dostać się głębiej.

source_text: How will you do it?

structure.raw_value: ErWoOp.How will you do it?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoOp.How will you do it?"

translation: Jak to zrobisz?

source_text: The place is crawling with those leper dudes. It won’t be easy.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.The place is crawling with those leper dudes. It won’t be easy.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.The place is crawling with those leper dudes. It won’t be easy."

translation: To miejsce roi się od tych trędowatych typów. Nie będzie łatwo.

source_text: I just hope to God I’m not some sort of planned sacrifice to Satan.

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.I just hope to God I’m not some sort of planned sacrifice to Satan.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl.I just hope to God I’m not some sort of planned sacrifice to Satan."

translation: Mam tylko nadzieję, że nie jestem przeznaczona na jakąś ofiarę dla Szatana.

source_text: From the looks of things, the Toma pieces appear to be part of some ritual.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.From the looks of things, the Toma pieces appear to be part of some ritual.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.From the looks of things, the Toma pieces appear to be part of some ritual."

translation: Wygląda na to, że fragmenty Tomy są częścią jakiegoś rytuału.

source_text: I don’t know what it could be, but I can try and find out.

structure.raw_value: ErBaEx.I don’t know what it could be, but I can try and find out.
structure.script_literal: "ErBaEx.I don’t know what it could be, but I can try and find out."

translation: Nie wiem, co to może być, ale spróbuję się dowiedzieć.
